A Sorvathi with a tall backswept skull ridged in three bony lines, slit nostrils in a flat bridge and a wide dark mouth, skin of deep teal shading to aquamarine at the throat, pupil-less sea-glass eyes, and two thick head-tails hanging past her shoulders.

A Kethran with plates of bronze-green chitin over the cheekbones and brow, fine scales like beaten metal across her face and throat, gold slit-pupil eyes, a low fin of translucent membrane from brow to nape, and a long tail carried curled behind her.

A Vessari-human hybrid with a human face under a pair of small backswept ivory horns, deep violet skin shading to lilac at the throat, a constellation of bioluminescent freckles across the cheekbones, wide amber eyes with horizontal pupils, and a mane of white hair.

An Ilyari with a bony faceplate of bone-white across the brow and cheeks, four sea-green eyes in two stacked pairs, skin veined faintly with teal light, small pointed ears, and heavy ink-black tentacle-locks that move slightly on their own.

A Marrowen with a ring of short jet horns around a smooth patterned scalp, skin like polished obsidian shot with veins of slow orange light, a jaw frill of fine black spines, and pupil-less eyes of solid molten gold.

A Quell-human hybrid with a human face carrying a scattering of small iridescent scales along the cheekbones and temples, skin of pale gold, eyes of faceted emerald with no white, and long silver quills swept back over her shoulders.

A Drevathi with wide-set compound eyes of shifting indigo facets, a fanned jaw frill of translucent amber membrane, skin of deep coral plated in overlapping chitin across the brow and throat, and four arms ending in long tapered fingers.

A Vraxi with a low wide skull, brow plates of dark amber chitin, skin of deep sea-blue that fades to grey-green at the jaw, pupil-less eyes of solid silver, and a cluster of fine bioluminescent tendrils hanging from the back of the skull like gathered kelp.

A Pelhari-human hybrid with a full human face carrying two curving obsidian horns swept back above the ears, skin of rich teal with a faint iridescent sheen at the temples, wide eyes of deep copper with slit pupils, and a long scaled tail.

A Choressi with a smooth elongated skull, cheek plates of dark green chitin, skin of deep forest-bronze patterned in dark rosettes down the neck, three amber eyes set in a shallow triangle across the face, and dense black plumes fanning from the crown.

An Asshari with a broad ridged forehead of layered bone, a lipless mouth wide and dark, skin of deep crimson shading to burgundy at the jaw, pupil-less eyes of cold white glass, and a bare scalp patterned in raised spiral ridges of darker red.

A Sorathi with a swept skull carrying a single central bony ridge from brow to nape, skin of gold deepening to dark amber at the cheeks and throat, wide eyes of solid black ringed in a thin line of amber, and a mass of hollow quills of pale gold cascading from the crown.

A Vethrani with a round-boned wide jaw, no visible nose bridge and slit nostrils flat to the face, skin of deep violet mottled in slow-shifting darker patches, four eyes set wide and pale as moonstones, and a bare scalp covered in raised iridescent scales of blue-green.

A Caeryn-human hybrid with a human face bearing two thin curving facial ridges from brow to cheekbone, skin of warm coral shot with faint rose-gold shimmer, eyes of deep amber with horizontal pupils, and a fall of hair that shades from copper at the root to white at the tip.

A Thylkai with a tall backswept skull flanked by swept bone horns above the ears, skin of deep blue-black like wet slate, cheek plates of smooth dark chitin, wide eyes of luminous green with no pupil, and a loose drape of thick ink-blue tentacle-locks behind her.

A Vorressi with a compact ridged skull, a fanned jaw frill of thin coral membrane edged in white, skin of warm bronze patterned in pale gold ocelli down the throat, pupil-less eyes of deep amber, and two pairs of arms each ending in fine clawed hands.

An Ulhari-human hybrid with a full human face, a scatter of tiny bioluminescent spots across the brow and cheeks in pale blue, skin of deep plum shading to lilac at the jaw, wide dark eyes with a second transparent inner eyelid, and a long flexible tail.

A Shelhari with a wide low skull, brow and cheekbone plates of layered bone-white chitin, skin of deep jade green that becomes translucent at the throat revealing dark traceries beneath, six small eyes in a shallow arc, and a bare scalp covered in dense short crystal filaments of pale green.

A Rovathi with a tall ridged skull flanked by two swept bony brow plates, a wide lipless mouth, skin of burnished copper-red patterned in dark chevrons down the neck, pale slit-pupil eyes of cold silver, and digitigrade legs.

A Dhalvori-human hybrid with a human face and slim curving scales of teal along each temple and jaw, skin of warm deep gold, eyes of solid pale violet with fine dark striations, and a fall of long silver-white hair carrying faint blue light at the tips.

A Thesshari with a swept elongated skull bearing two curving cheek-frills of rigid dark membrane, skin of deep sea-blue-green like oxidized bronze, pupil-less eyes of pale molten gold, and a dense growth of fine dark teal plumes from crown to nape in place of hair.
